MARKETPLACE / SELECTED PROJECT

CUIDAAPR

Helping people discover and book caregivers around their location and care needs.

MY ROLE

UI/UX design

PROJECT SCOPE

Mobile marketplace

FOCUS

Caregiver marketplace · Mobile

The challenge.

Finding a suitable caregiver requires people to understand their options and move confidently from discovery to booking.

The approach.

I designed a mobile experience that brings service discovery, caregiver comparison, care requests, and booking into a coherent journey.

Design decisions.

  • Make location and care needs useful starting points for discovery.
  • Support comparison of caregiver options.
  • Give care requests and booking a clear place in the flow.
  • Keep important service information accessible on mobile.
